description.value: You've learned that striking before the enemy is often what keeps you alive. When you make a ranged weapon attack against a creature that hasn't yet acted in your first turn of combat, and you have advantage on that roll, you may reroll one of the two dice once. On a hit, you also deal an extra 1d8 damage matching the weapon's type, which grows to 1d10 at 13th level and 1d12 at 17th level.
